path.description: Path to the CLEANED JSONL a dataflow produced (control-side copy — the SSH engine fetches export outputs back). Its rows are what a later batch's cross-batch probe dedups against.
path.title: Path

dataset_id.description: Logical dataset this batch belongs to — the index is scoped to it. Empty means 'no cross-batch identity', and publishing is skipped.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

batch_id.description: This batch's id; a probe excludes it so a batch never dedups against itself.
batch_id.title: Batch Id

normalize.description: Collapse whitespace before hashing — MUST match the setting the dedup stage used, or the published hashes won't line up with what a future probe computes.
normalize.title: Normalize
